prompt.title: AEGEMS Workflow Policy
append_system_rules: For AEGEMS, workflow retry decisions must follow the failure-log and health-check flow before any retry action.
If Life Asia or TEBT is involved, always confirm the related application health before retrying the workflow.
response_notes: Keep the wording concise and business-friendly for operations users.
When a retry is blocked, mention the dependent application is unavailable and ask the user to try later.

messages.retry_blocked_unhealthy: {application} is currently unavailable for AEGEMS. Please try again later.
messages.retry_allowed_healthy: {application} is healthy for AEGEMS. Retrying workflow now...
